module: Non-shipping diagnostic of the router: attributes each navigate() call to the calling Lua module (walking up the stack ignoring "ui/router/" files) and warns when a navigation preempts another still in progress (active transition replaced, or navigate() whose epoch was incremented by a reentrant navigate() during its guards/onEnter). Each preemption is classified duplicate_navigation (identical requests: route, params, scope, options) or conflicting_navigation. It has no effect on the router's behavior: it records attempts and writes warnings.
notes: Must be loaded and called only if shipping_build ~= true (router.lua guarantees it).

The warning message is written with the log tag "LuaRouterObserver" at level W, in the form "<category>: navigation from <source> [route=… scope=…] preempted by … (phase: …); check and fix duplicate navigation".
The source is {module, file, func, line} of the first non-router frame within the first 24 stack levels; otherwise module = "bridge/unknown" (call coming from the engine/UI).
A given preempted attempt is never reported twice, and an attempt does not preempt itself.
Phase values used by router.lua: active_transition, post_guard, post_enter.

beginAttempt.desc: Starts a new attempt on entering navigate() by capturing the external Lua caller. Must be called before any router wrapper.

returns.desc: Attempt {id, source, route, params, scope, options} (the last four filled in by attachResolvedTarget).

attachResolvedTarget.desc: Associates the resolved target (full route, effective parameters, scope, options) with an attempt.

getCurrentAttempt.desc: Returns the last attempt started (a reentrant navigate() overwrites the previous one).

reportPreemption.desc: Reports a confirmed preemption: classifies the pair of attempts, writes a single warning and returns the record. Does nothing if an attempt is missing, if they are the same or if the preempted one has already been reported.

phase.desc: Label indicating where the preemption was detected.

returns.desc: {category, phase, preempted, replacement} or nil if nothing was reported.

reset.desc: Resets the observer (current attempt, counter, attempts already reported).
